description: Create (or fetch the existing) public share URL for a wantlist, deck, or tradelist. kind "wantlist": the cards still MISSING from a deck — or from the personal wantlist when no deck is given. kind "deck": the full decklist with prices. By default it is the list alone — card names, any printing. show_printings:true adds the exact printing and finish of the copies in the deck (else the printing the list pins); show_proxies:true adds which copies are proxies. ASK the user which they want before sharing a deck that contains proxies or special printings. Passing either option for a deck that is already shared changes the existing link in place (same URL). kind "tradelist" with a location: every card physically there (typically "Trade Binder"), with condition and prices. kind "tradelist" WITHOUT a location: the user's tradelist by rule, what `rule` picks — unclaimed (every copy no deck claims), spares_card (all but one copy of each card; a claimed copy counts as the one kept) or spares_printing (all but one of each printing). Default spares_card; passing rule on the existing link changes it in place. Explain what the rule publishes and ask before publishing it. keep_open (spares rules only, default false): true keeps one copy of each card even from decks open to trade, so a card the user owns once is never offered; false offers every copy an open deck claims. It applies to every tradelist the user publishes. Every tradelist also carries the claimed copies of decks marked open_to_trade (update_deck) and copies decks borrow as shared, each naming the deck a trade breaks (breaks_decks: the deck names are public on the page). A tradelist never lists a proxy. The URL is PUBLIC — anyone holding it can view the list until it is revoked; tell the user this when sharing something sensitive. Minting is idempotent per target: sharing the same thing again returns the same URL. Only a new kind "deck" link counts toward the plan (PLAN_LIMIT past it); a wantlist or tradelist link never does. Hand the user the full url — pasted into WhatsApp or iMessage it unfurls into a rich preview, and any Reliquary-connected assistant can read it via read_share_link.

deck.description: Deck id or name — required for kind "deck"; optional for "wantlist" (omit to share the personal wantlist)

keep_open.description: kind "tradelist" with no location only: under a spares rule, keep one copy of each card even from decks open to trade

location.description: Location id or name for a place's tradelist, e.g. "Trade Binder"; omit for the tradelist by rule

rule.description: kind "tradelist" with no location only: what the tradelist by rule offers

show_printings.description: kind "deck" only. Show the exact printings the owner plays. Default false on a new link; omitted keeps an existing link's setting.

show_proxies.description: kind "deck" only. Show which copies are proxies. Default false on a new link; omitted keeps an existing link's setting.
